Salesforce Proposal Presentation
Life Sciences Cloud

An immersive, end-to-end demonstration designed to bring Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud to life through realistic Tecnimede scenarios. The session will showcase how the platform can empower Commercial, Medical and supporting teams with connected data, intuitive experiences, compliant engagement and AI-assisted capabilities — while highlighting the standard functionality, flexibility and innovation that can support Tecnimede’s future operating model.

  • HCP & HCO Account Management
  • Key Account & Territory Planning
  • Marketing Automation & Consents
  • Sample Management
  • Order Entry & Trade Marketing
  • Medical Affairs & Medical Information
  • Event Management
  • Mobile & Offline Field Experience
  • AI & Recommendations
  • Administration & Platform Autonomy
